description: This is a Java test class for testing loan creation, disbursement, and repayment schedules with fixed principal percentage amortization in the Apache Fineract project. It includes multiple test methods that set up loan parameters, create loans, and verify repayment schedules under different interest calculation methods.

classes.name: LoanFixedPrincipalPercentageAmortizationTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying loan repayment schedules under fixed principal percentage amortization with different interest types and scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured and sets up request and response specifications before each test.

methods.name: checkLoanCreateAndDisburseFlowWithFixedPrincipalPercentage
methods.description: Tests creating, disbursing a loan with fixed principal percentage, and validates the repayment schedule.

methods.name: checkLoanCreateAndDisburseFlowWithFixedPrincipalPercentageWithPrincipalGrace
methods.description: Tests loan creation with principal grace period and validates the repayment schedule.

methods.name: checkLoanCreateAndDisburseFlowWithFixedPrincipalPercentageAndFlatInterest
methods.description: Tests loan with flat interest rate and verifies the repayment schedule.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a loan product with specified parameters for amortization and interest calculation.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Submits a loan application for a client and a loan product with specified principal and other parameters.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Adds collateral details to a loan application.

methods.name: collaterals
methods.description: Creates a collateral map for application.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplicationWithPrincipalGrace
methods.description: Submits a loan application with a principal grace period.

methods.name: verifyLoanRepaymentScheduleForEqualPrincipal
methods.description: Verifies the repayment schedule with fixed principal payments for each installment.

methods.name: verifyLoanRepaymentScheduleForEqualPrincipalWithPrincipalGrace
methods.description: Verifies the repayment schedule with principal grace applied.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithFlatInterest
methods.description: Creates a loan product with flat interest rate specification.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplicationWithFlatInterest
methods.description: Submits a loan application with flat interest rate configured.

methods.name: verifyLoanRepaymentScheduleForEqualPrincipalAndFlatInterest
methods.description: Verifies the repayment schedule details for a loan with flat interest rate.
